children: Bayer AG (XETR:BAYN) is advancing oncology, cardiology and sustainability: sevabertinib won FDA accelerated first‑line approval for HER2‑mutant NSCLC after strong Phase 1/2 results, a Phase II GIRK4 inhibitor trial for atrial fibrillation launched, and iodine and NewGold canola scale‑up plans aim industrial supply for pharma and biofuels.
: Bayer (BAYN) won FDA accelerated approval for sevabertinib as first‑line for advanced HER2‑mutant NSCLC. Phase 1/2 showed 75% ORR, 6% CR, ~73% durable ≥6 months; confirmatory Phase III ongoing.
Global Phase II Trial For BAY 3670549

: Bayer (BAYN) launched a global Phase II randomized, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled trial of BAY 3670549, a GIRK4 inhibitor, in adults with atrial fibrillation to assess efficacy, safety and PK/PD.
: Bayer AG (BAYN) and Voyageur plan staged iodine output: start 200 t/yr, expand to 1,000 t/yr. Feasibility study could lead to long-term offtake and central USP pharmaceutical-grade production.
: Bayer AG (BAYN) agreed with Neste to scale NewGold Winter Canola for biofuel use, combining Bayer’s canola trait tech with Neste’s biofuel processing capabilities.
